sourceEnglishSpeaking: You are the crew lead and the AI is the supplier: find out what is missing and when it will arrive, compare the substitute with the original product, and say what you will do next using the future and ir a.

reader.sourceSpanish: A las siete, el proveedor llamó a Rogelio con malas noticias.
reader.sourceEnglish: At seven, the supplier called Rogelio with bad news.

reader.archivedEnglish: At seven, the supplier called Rogelio with bad news.

reader.sourceSpanish: Proveedor: Lo siento, el pedido no llegará completo, porque no tenemos ese color en existencia.
reader.sourceEnglish: Supplier: I'm sorry, the order won't arrive complete, because we don't have that color in stock.

reader.archivedJapanese: 仕入先「申し訳ありません。あの色の在庫がないため、注文品は全部そろって届きません。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Supplier: I'm sorry, the order won't arrive complete, because we don't have that color in stock.

reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: When will the rest arrive?
reader.candidateJapanese: ロヘリオ「残りはいつ届きますか。」
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「残りはいつ届きますか。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: When will the rest arrive?

reader.sourceSpanish: Proveedor: La fábrica dice que llegará a la bodega el jueves, pero no es seguro.
reader.sourceEnglish: Supplier: The factory says it will arrive at the warehouse on Thursday, but it's not certain.

reader.archivedJapanese: 仕入先「工場は木曜日に倉庫へ届くと言っていますが、確実ではありません。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Supplier: The factory says it will arrive at the warehouse on Thursday, but it's not certain.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: Eso sería un retraso de cuatro días, y la clienta quiere terminar antes.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: That would be a four-day delay, and the customer wants to finish sooner.
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「それでは四日の遅れになります。お客様はもっと早い完成を望んでいます。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: That would be a four-day delay, and the customer wants to finish sooner.
reader.reviewNote: Source says would be a four-day delay; preserve conditional timing, not certainty.

reader.sourceSpanish: Proveedor: Tengo la misma teja arquitectónica de otra marca, al mismo precio.
reader.sourceEnglish: Supplier: I have the same architectural shingle from another brand, at the same price.
reader.archivedJapanese: 仕入先「別のブランドに同じラミネートシングル材があり、価格も同じです。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Supplier: I have the same architectural shingle from another brand, at the same price.
reader.reviewNote: Another-brand architectural shingle at the same price is a supplier product claim.

reader.sourceSpanish: Proveedor: Es igual de resistente, pero más pesada, y el color se parece mucho.
reader.sourceEnglish: Supplier: It's just as durable, but heavier, and the color is very similar.
reader.archivedJapanese: 仕入先「耐久性は同じですが、より重く、色もよく似ています。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Supplier: It's just as durable, but heavier, and the color is very similar.
reader.reviewNote: Equal durability, higher weight and similar color require product/specification review.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: La arquitectónica de otra marca me sirve, pero no voy a aceptar teja de tres lengüetas; el contrato dice arquitectónica.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: The architectural one from another brand works for me, but I'm not going to accept three-tab shingle; the contract says architectural.
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「別ブランドのラミネート材なら使えますが、三枚タブシングル材は受け入れません。契約書にはラミネート材とあります。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: The architectural one from another brand works for me, but I'm not going to accept three-tab shingle; the contract says architectural.
reader.reviewNote: Contract distinguishes architectural from three-tab; Japanese product terms and authority need review.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: Mándeme la hoja técnica, y antes de decidir voy a hablar con la clienta.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: Send me the spec sheet, and before deciding I'm going to talk to the customer.
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「仕様書を送ってください。決める前にお客様と話します。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: Send me the spec sheet, and before deciding I'm going to talk to the customer.
reader.reviewNote: Spec-sheet comparison must precede a substitute decision; confirm workflow and term.

reader.sourceSpanish: Luego Rogelio llamó a la señora Díaz, la dueña de la casa.
reader.sourceEnglish: Then Rogelio called Mrs. Díaz, the homeowner.

reader.reviewNote: Next-day delivery depends on homeowner approval and supplier availability; hold promise wording.

curriculumAdaptationNote: The source's Thursday factory delivery is uncertain; a same-price architectural-shingle substitute from another brand is a supplier claim, not verified equivalence. Rogelio rejects three-tab under the contract, requests the spec sheet, consults Mrs. Díaz, receives text approval and a new invoice, then re-sequences underlayment and drip edge. Preserve conditional delivery, heavier-versus-durable comparison, product identity, source register and homeowner authorization. Roofing product/contract and Japanese review are needed before scored text or audio. Five source verbs and grammar examples remain pinned separately; archived forms and mode labels are conditional evidence. No learner or saved-progress identity is created.
